### When It Feels Like God Isn't Listening to Our Prayers (Matthew 15:21-28)
Author: April Motl
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/your-daily-bible-verse/when-it-feels-like-god-isn-t-listening-to-our-prayers-bible-study-minute-march-6-2019.html
Passage: Matthew 15:21-28
Points:
- When God seems quiet, He is not ignoring us but preparing our faith.
- Emulate the Canaanite woman by persistently crying out to Jesus in prayer.
- Approach the Lord with genuine humility rather than demanding entitlement.
- Expect Christ to meet you because He cares generously for the weak.
- Maintain gratitude for any portion or mercy the Lord chooses to grant.
